title: Cloudflare explains Tuesday’s outage that temporarily took down ChatGPT
summary: A blog post published Tuesday night by Cloudflare co-founder and CEO Matthew Prince has details on what caused its “worst outage since 2019,” pinning the issue to a problem in the Bot Management system that is supposed to control which automated crawlers are allowed to scan particular websites using its CDN. title: Today's Options Tape shows interesting Trades of Big Whales

Not an “end of the world” read, but definitely not risk-on either.A few that jumped off the screen:TSMhad a couple chunkyput buys. One was the01/30/26 315Pfor about$1.22Mpremium (block, at ask). Another was01/23/26 310Paround$502K. That’s the kind of print that usually isn’t random.QQQwas a bit split. There was a bearish02/27/26 575Paround$575K, but also a bullish02/27/26 636Caround$508K.
